correctness.rationale: A uniqueness-preserving recursion exhausts all monotone Boolean functions through five variables; boundary filtering reproduces 1,4,18,166,7579 simple games. Exact rational calculations verify no Johnston/Banzhaf or Johnston/Shapley weak-order divergence for n<=4. Canonicalization under all 120 permutations gives 208 five-player classes, 34 divergent classes, and one sparsest three-minimal-winning-coalition orbit. The explicit witness vectors were recomputed exactly.

value.rationale: Ordinal equivalence of these three canonical voting-power indices is an established structural question in the literature. The exact first failure size, complete first-order isomorphism census, and unique sparsest witness class are natural finite invariants of that question, not an arbitrary parameter slice; they identify how early and how structurally sparse Johnston can depart from the two classical swing-orderings.
